propositions: JiraConfig currently accepts non-https jira.url without validation, allowing credentials to be transmitted in cleartext
DC's ReconcilerConfig validates and rejects non-https reconciler.base_url unless allow_insecure is set, but Cloud's JiraConfig has no equivalent __post_init__ validation
Config consumers swallow ConfigError during jira config load (resolve_jira_settings, _jira_onboard._detect), allowing insecure configs to silently degrade to env-only mode instead of failing loud
write_jira_config persists jira.url without scheme validation, so the onboarding wizard can write cleartext urls silently

Generalized _validate_https_url with allow_insecure override and InsecureUrlError must be enforced at JiraConfig load time and write_jira_config persist time to fail loud and prevent cleartext credentials
